description.value: The high-density, pulpy meristematic tissue that makes up hardor leaves has restorative properties, and you've trained from a young age to use them. No matter how few supplies may be available, you can make a small incision and use a tiny part of yourself to heal others. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You can attempt a Medicine check to Administer First Aid or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Treat Wounds] without a medkit by losing 1 Hit Point. This damage can't be resisted, prevented, or negated in any way.
